records.Japanese:
ああ提督、いいところへ
負傷者が出たので、水夫を募集して
いるところです。よろしければご指示を
records.english: Good timing, Admiral. Some of our crew were wounded, so I'm recruiting sailors. Would you like to take over?
records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.context: Hodram finds Gerhard recruiting replacements after injuries. The player can take charge and hear about recruiting and provisioning, or leave it to Gerhard.
records.source_meaning: Gerhard explains the injuries and ongoing recruitment before inviting Hodram's direction. The invitation leads naturally to the two answers.
records.localization_note: Gerhard explains the injuries and ongoing recruitment before inviting Hodram's direction. The invitation leads naturally to the two answers.

records.Japanese:
客に酒でもふるまってやれば、仕事を
探しているような連中が寄ってきます
から、その後に水夫を募るのが
手っ取り早いでしょう
records.english: Buy the house a round and anyone looking for work will come over. Then you can recruit them quickly.
records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.context: Hodram finds Gerhard recruiting replacements after injuries. The player can take charge and hear about recruiting and provisioning, or leave it to Gerhard.
records.source_meaning: Gerhard proposes buying drinks for the patrons to draw people looking for work, making it quicker to recruit.
records.localization_note: Keep 'will come over' together and preserve the source's emphasis on recruiting quickly.
records.previous_English: Buy the house a round and people looking for work are sure to come over. That makes it easy to recruit sailors.

records.Japanese:
白兵戦主体に戦うつもりなら
水夫は多めに雇っておくべきですが
艦隊の航続距離は短くなるので
注意してください
records.english: Relying on boarding battles? Hire plenty of sailors. Just remember, a larger crew reduces your fleet's cruising range.
records.speaker: Speakerless panel
